source_findings: Article metadata matches DOI 10.1038/s41522-024-00637-y, PMID 39779734, and PMCID PMC11711674.
Primary XML Table 1 reports colistin/DJK-5 MIC values in ug/mL and FICI values for P. aeruginosa LESB58 and S. aureus USA300 LAC.
The article states daptomycin/DJK-5 combinatorial effects were determined in Supplementary Table 1, but that supplement is not locally available as a real PDF/table.
All ten local supplementary .bin files inspected through the packet/landed roots resolve as HTML article landing pages, and supplementary_tables.json has table_count=0.
linked_sequence_records.jsonl has zero rows; the local XML/PDF name DJK-5 and D-enantiomeric context but do not embed exact sequence/modification evidence.
material_review.stop_condition: No local primary/supplementary path inspected contains Supplementary Table 1/source-data values or exact DJK-5 sequence/modification evidence; source verification cannot proceed unless new local material is supplied.

worker6_adjudication.layer_1_summary: All 28 sampled rows are DBAASP database audit rows. Final/release outputs preserve unresolved_record or database_only_no_primary_source and do not promote rows to source_verified without primary sequence/modification evidence.
